description: Battlefield 2 Complete Collection (DICE/EA 2005, v1.50 preinstalled repack, via Proton)
long: Large-scale modern-combat warfare across land, sea and air. Battlefield 2 pits two teams over sprawling maps with jets, helicopters, tanks and transports, a commander layer with UAV/artillery support, and squad-based play. This Complete Collection bundles the Special Forces, Euro Force and Armored Fury expansions.
